title: add_drop silently ignores invalid privacy values unlike render_post
description: render_post (lines 600-611) explicitly rejects invalid privacy values with 4.00 Bad Request. However, add_drop (lines 499-501) silently ignores invalid SenML privacy fields and falls back to the caller-provided privacy parameter. Internal callers of add_drop may expect validation to occur. File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/deaddrop.py lines 499-501
